status: Declared by T01 and confirmed by the owner on 2026-10-31, before any incumbent/candidate comparison. Revise only before the T04 comparison runs, with the reason recorded. Revised 2026-10-31 before T04: the owner confirmed T02's proposed host-condition gate. Revised again before the T04 comparison runs: a 4 GiB family limit for the incumbent's representative jobs, with the reason in limits.incumbentReason.

limits.scope: Native and representative-sample jobs; full-suite parity runs use each consumer's authoritative path and limits
limits.incumbentReason: Revised 2026-10-31 before the T04 comparison runs: the incumbent's representative Storybook Vitest job reached 2.0 GB (FAST-AF) and exceeded 2 GiB (Lushly) in smoke runs, so the 2 GiB limit would stop the baseline itself. The candidate keeps 2 GiB; the incumbent's peak remains an outcome metric.

sampling.memoryMetric: process-accounted phys_footprint summed per simultaneous sample (macOS)
sampling.cpuMetric: waited root plus reaped descendant user+system core-seconds

cache.cold: First render after process start with an emptied Vite dependency cache and a fresh browser profile; OS file cache not flushed
cache.warm: Subsequent render in the same process with populated Vite transform/dependency caches; every render keeps a fresh browser context
cache.incumbentCold: Storybook Vitest run after removing node_modules/.cache/storybook and node_modules/.vite in the snapshot
cache.incumbentWarm: Immediate rerun of the same Storybook Vitest selection

workers.specimenIsolated: Opt-in process worker reused across related captures and closed explicitly

incumbentMaxWorkers.fast-af: Vitest default for the storybook project

samples.repetitionOrder: ABBA for paired cells; held, failed and diagnostic runs supply no ratios

repeatability.rule: Two repetitions of one cell differing by more than this are unstable: rerun or hold the cell, and derive no ratio from it

tolerances.noiseFloorRule: A median difference within this band is reported as no measurable difference, not as a reduction or regression

acceptance.cpuPerVerifiedCase: Candidate median at most the incumbent median for equivalent verified work
acceptance.activePeakFootprint: Candidate median at most the incumbent median
acceptance.postCloseFootprint: Candidate median at most the incumbent median
acceptance.coldStartupLatency: Candidate median at most 1.25 times the incumbent median
acceptance.warmRenderLatency: Candidate median at most 1.25 times the incumbent median
acceptance.rule: CPU and memory are the outcome; latency is a guardrail. A savings claim also requires the difference to exceed the noise floor.

hostCondition.reason: T02 found cross-session CPU tracks host contention (probe correlation r = 0.999 / 0.960), so admission alone does not make jobs comparable
hostCondition.probe: Fixed-work speed probe (experiments/resources/speed-probe.mjs), one run before and one after every job
hostCondition.pairRule: A comparison pair counts only when every job's before and after probe CPU seconds are at most 1.10 times the session's quietest probe; otherwise the pair is held and supplies no ratio
hostCondition.quietWindow: Measurements start only after experiments/resources/quiet.mjs reports a full quiet window; the gate is a precondition, not evidence
